tilemapOrder: row-major, top-to-bottom; indices are 0-based atlas frames
runtimeComposition: Native-scale pixel tiles and furniture compose three connected 288x144 rooms. Camera follows the player across both doors and reveals the neighboring doorway during transitions; dynamic actors and clues render separately.
propsCoordinateGrid: art tile cells, 54x9, 16 logical px per cell across three rooms
propsPlacementStatus: native-scale room-specific furniture placements; collision footprints stored in furnitureCells
walkableEncoding: 1=floor; solidCells override floor for walls, furniture, and clue objects
connectivity: 4-neighbor; spawn connects to all eight character and clue approach cells across three rooms
anchorLookup: col=min(107,floor(108*x)); row=min(17,floor(18*y)); lookup only, never snap rendered entities to cell centers

presentation.otherStageScale: uniform contain preserving the 288x144 room aspect ratio; camera follows the player across both internal doors
presentation.screenFromNormalized: screen coordinates map to the active native-aspect room viewport
presentation.touchToNormalized: inverse room viewport plus camera offset; clamp x/y to [0,1]
presentation.cameraBehavior: center player in the 288x144 viewport when possible; clamp at world edges so doors remain traversable in both directions

interaction.distantTarget: walk to its free approach cell; next action interacts
